ordered_diagnoses: mucosal melanoma of the glans penis

s1.syndrome_frame: Painful swelling and ulceration of the glans penis with systemic symptoms
salient_findings: Painful swelling and ulceration of the glans penis
Grossly edematous glans penis and corona
Tender, firm ulcer on the ventral surface of the penis with overlying black eschar and granulation tissue
Inguinal lymphadenopathy
Systemic symptoms including fatigue, weight loss, and loss of appetite
key_facts: 78-year-old man presented with painful swelling and ulceration of the glans penis
Symptoms duration of 1 month
Previous medical history included elevated white blood cell count and inguinal lymphadenopathy
Previous treatments with topical antibiotics, antifungal agents, hydrogen peroxide soaks, warm compresses, and cephalexin showed no improvement
Routine blood test results were within normal limits
Cultures, assays, and blood tests evaluating for viral, bacterial, or fungal etiology were negative
Biopsy of the glans penis ulcer showed dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphocytes
PCR analysis revealed a clonal IgH gene rearrangement
PET-CT scan demonstrated FDG-avid abdominal and peripancreatic lymph nodes

shortlist: mucosal melanoma of the glans penis

shortlist.label: diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: clonal IgH gene rearrangement and dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphocytes

shortlist.label: cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphocytes and reactive T-cell infiltrate

shortlist.label: extranodal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: systemic symptoms and FDG-avid abdominal and peripancreatic lymph nodes

shortlist.label: mucosal melanoma of the glans penis
shortlist.why_kept: ulceration and black eschar on the glans penis

shortlist.label: squamous cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: ulceration and granulation tissue on the glans penis

raw.rationale: The presence of atypical lymphocytes that are CD20+, CD79a+, and CD5+ in the biopsy, along with a clonal IgH gene rearrangement, strongly supports a diagnosis of B-cell lymphoma, specifically diffuse large B-cell lymphoma given the large cell morphology and the extranodal involvement.

rejected.label: cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: The lymphocytes are CD20+, indicating a B-cell origin rather than T-cell

rejected.label: extranodal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: The presence of CD20+ and CD79a+ cells and a clonal IgH gene rearrangement points towards a B-cell lymphoma rather than a T-cell or NK-cell lymphoma

rejected.label: mucosal melanoma of the glans penis
rejected.why: The biopsy shows atypical lymphocytes, not melanocytes, and there's no mention of melanin pigment or other features suggestive of melanoma

rejected.label: squamous cell carcinoma
rejected.why: The biopsy shows a dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphocytes, not squamous cell carcinoma cells, and there's no mention of features typical for squamous cell carcinoma like keratin pearls
